Which of one of the following statements about the postnatal growth of the maxilla is correct?
Option A: Pneumatisation by enlargement of the developing maxillary sinus ceases at puberty
Option B: Space is created for the eruption of the permanent molars by resorption of the maxillary tuberosity
Option C: The zygomaticomaxillary sutures contribute to increase in height and length of the maxilla
Option D: The intermaxillary suture closes about eight years postnatally
